planner_notes: HunyuanImage-3.0 is an 80B-class mixed-MLP MoE causal transformer (32 layers, hidden=4096, 32 q-heads / 8 kv-heads, head_dim=128, 64 experts + 1 shared, top-8 routing, 2D-RoPE, qk-norm, RMSNorm). The full model.generate() is a 50-step diffusion image-generation loop over the whole 80B stack — infeasible to reproduce or to fit on a single device, so it is NOT the e2e gate target.

The bring-up (Source B) graduated exactly the transformer decoder-block internals. The faithful, device-feasible e2e that EXERCISES all graduated work is the model's real transformer forward (HunyuanImage3Model.forward) — inputs_embeds -> decoder layer(s) -> last_hidden_state — which is the exact tensor that feeds the CausalMM / image heads. Input is built from the REAL HF tokenizer + wte embedding + the model's REAL 2D-RoPE (build_2d_rope). Output (last_hidden_state, and the MoE load-balance l_aux) is compared to the HF reference forward of the same submodule chain.

Device-memory reality: one decoder layer = 64 routed + 1 shared SwiGLU experts (~4.9 GB bf16) + GQA attention; fits comfortably on one Blackhole chip. The full 32-layer stack is the whole 80B model and does NOT fit on one chip, so the e2e runs the graduated layer(s) as the real transformer block(s); NUM_LAYERS is configurable (default 1 = layer 0, the exact submodule that graduated).

graduated_modules_verification.rule: GRADUATED = has _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_native OR .last_good_sharded snapshot; REUSE (no stub) are NOT graduated.
graduated_modules_verification.count_check: 3 graduated stubs present; ALL 3 must be invoked in the pipeline (Gate 2).
graduated_modules_verification.nesting: These three nest: HunyuanImage3DecoderLayer.mlp = HunyuanMoE; HunyuanMoE.gate = HunyuanTopKGate. The pipeline composes them along this exact hierarchy so every graduated stub is on the one real forward path (no coverage sweep).

task_heads.name: hunyuan_image3_transformer_prefill
task_heads.description: Real HunyuanImage3 transformer forward (prefill): input_ids (from HF tokenizer on a real prompt) -> wte embedding -> N graduated decoder layers -> last_hidden_state, plus the summed MoE load-balance l_aux. This is the exact tensor path that HunyuanImage3Model.forward produces to feed the downstream CausalMM/image heads.
task_heads.agents: ONE agent — all three graduated stubs are nested in this single decoder-block chain, so per the orchestration rule they are built together, not split.
wiring: stage embed:  ttnn.embedding(input_ids, wte.weight)  -> inputs_embeds  [1, S, 4096]  (on device)

stage layer_i (x N): image3_decoder_layer(x, custom_pos_emb) -> internally: input_layernorm(RMSNorm) -> GQA self-attn (fused-qkv, HF-rope via real build_2d_rope cos/sin, qk-norm, SDPA, o_proj) -> residual -> post_attention_layernorm -> mo_e(x2) -> residual
stage mo_e (inside layer): shared SwiGLU + routed experts combined by the router weights returned from top_k_gate; returns (moe_out, l_aux)
stage top_k_gate (inside mo_e): softmax over experts + top-8 -> normalized router weights (FEED the expert combine = main path) AND l_aux (load-balance aux, a real forward co-output)
output: last_hidden_state = layer_{N-1} output; aux = sum of per-layer l_aux
task_heads.input_source: Source A HF tokenizer (tencent/HunyuanImage-3.0) on a fixed real prompt; wte embedding + build_2d_rope(seq_len, head_dim=128) taken from the loaded HF reference (setup only). Identical custom_pos_emb fed to BOTH TT and HF golden.
task_heads.output_definition: last_hidden_state [1, S, 4096] (primary) + total l_aux scalar (auxiliary). Both are quantities HunyuanImage3Model.forward / HunyuanMoE genuinely compute.
task_heads.golden: _hf_reference() runs the SAME first-N HunyuanImage3DecoderLayer modules on the SAME inputs_embeds + custom_pos_emb -> last_hidden_state; and the reference HunyuanTopKGate/topkgating l_aux. No diffusion, no generate().

pass_criteria.gate1_native: Every routed graduated stub runs real ttnn ops on device (no torch fallback in the hot path). Verified by an import-time / runtime scan (no torch.* compute in run_prefill/__call__/_attention/_moe/_swiglu) and by host_op_selftest firing ZERO host aten ops in the observed forward.
pass_criteria.gate2_invoked: All 3 graduated stubs (image3_decoder_layer, mo_e, top_k_gate) are invoked on the real forward path with outputs feeding downstream: top_k_gate.router -> mo_e expert-combine -> decoder-layer residual -> last_hidden_state. Asserted via a real per-instance call registry (NOT a coverage sweep).
pass_criteria.gate3_pcc: final e2e PCC(last_hidden_state_TT, last_hidden_state_HF) >= 0.95. Printed as `e2e PCC=<v>` on its own line before the assert on every run. l_aux PCC reported alongside.

validation_metric: comp_pcc (models.common.utility_functions) on last_hidden_state vs HF golden; target 0.95 (per-component graduated at >=0.9996, so >=0.95 e2e expected).
behavioral_proof: The demo entrypoint (demo/demo_image3_prefill.py) tokenizes a real prompt with the HF tokenizer, runs the shared TTNN pipeline, and prints the last_hidden_state stats + a small slice, demonstrating the transformer produced real activations from real text — not a smoke test. The e2e test drives the identical shared pipeline and asserts the gates.
self_validation_plan: 2. Gate 2 registry: pipeline records each graduated stub instance actually called during run_prefill; test asserts the set == {image3_decoder_layer, mo_e, top_k_gate}.
3. Gate 3: e2e PCC(last_hidden_state) >= 0.95 vs HF reference decoder-stack forward; l_aux PCC reported.
4. Gate 1: host_op_selftest() runs the forward under host_op_observer.observe_host_ops with tokenize+wte+rope OUTSIDE the observed region and asserts ZERO host aten ops.

5. Command 3: trace_capture_selftest() captures each PIPELINE_STAGE (prefill, decode) host-free and PCC-checks the trace output; build_pipeline(device, model) returns the resident pipeline object exposing the per-stage trace_setup/trace_step/write_inputs hooks.

package_layout.tt/pipeline.py: the ONE shared chained forward (build_pipeline factory + run_prefill + stubs wiring + trace/host-op selftests) imported by BOTH demo and test
package_layout.tt/stubs/: the three graduated stubs (image3_decoder_layer, mo_e, top_k_gate), composed along the HF nesting
package_layout.demo/demo_image3_prefill.py: runnable `python -m ...demo.demo_image3_prefill` — real prompt -> TT prefill -> real last_hidden_state
